text.content:
An old Media with a camera, a skull plug and final cut.

Role: Media
Status: Eighty-five, still working, declared dead twice
Where to find them: A bar he won't name; Lizzie's Bar; the Afterlife
Known for: Writing Free City, the 2070 guide to Night City

A Media in Night City since before most edgerunners' parents were chipped. He covered the leftovers of the Mob Wars, the Corporate Wars, the bomb (he was eleven blocks away), the Red and the Purge, and has been shot, sued, blacklisted, fired by three networks and declared dead twice. He drinks tequila for his heart.

In 2070 the fixer Sable offered him final cut and no corporate edits to write a guide to the city to go with her rulebook. He walked the city again, district by district, and interviewed Fury, Stop Sign, Lattice and Doc Mags along the way. The result, Free City, is opinionated, sometimes wrong, and openly biased against every corporation alive.

He has spent twenty-three years trying to learn what happened on Static Night, and keeps the footage N54 cut: the crater in 2023, Laguna Bend in 2062, the Mox riots of 2067. Arasaka's PR people have asked to buy his 2023 footage four times this year; so has Minako Arasaka.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.00, 02, 05
